notes: The app now opens as one window and goes straight to the counter, instead of showing a small window first and then replacing it with another.
If the app cannot start, it now says why and offers to try again, instead of just closing.
Some small labels were too light to read against the cream background. They are darker now.
A "Due" reminder now shows in a warm colour instead of blue.
Better support for working by keyboard, and for screen-reading software.
If the app is ever slow to open, Help then About now points to a file that says which step was slow.
